name: The Brush Fee
pitch: They fire one art, you copy it five times, and all five copies are billed to them before the first hit lands.

new.name: Stele-Rubbing Scripture
new.effect: Secret art, Thiên giai, Water. Grants Rubbings, arts that take c_art, kind and tags from the enemy art fired that instant. Those slots hold nothing of your own.

new.name: Brush Fee
new.effect: The cost of a copied art is charged to the original's caster, who pays what they have.

new.name: Copied Art Damage
new.effect: +20 to arts with the copied tag.

new.name: Practised Stroke
new.effect: +8 points per firing of the original this fight, to +64.
new.second_home: any repeating art, Late Bloom builds

new.name: Dark Ink
new.effect: +50 points from Way of Ink art nodes on copied arts.

new.name: Sized Paper
new.effect: +30 points to copied and talisman hits, from treated paper prepared before the fight.

new.name: Deep Reading
new.second_home: any soul build, as a read on soul arts

new.name: Usurious Ink
new.effect: When a fee is charged at double, curse: +50 % art cost for 2 pulses.

new.name: Patronage
new.effect: When the enemy cannot afford a ready art, you pay its cost, while your pool is above that cost.
new.second_home: any build that forces the enemy to act

new.name: Kept Rubbing
new.effect: A Rubbing keeps its last copy between fights and fires it on a 3 s timer at your own cost until it copies something new.
new.second_home: any loadout that reads the last fight

new.name: Reversed Proof
new.effect: Rubbing: kind swapped between body and qi, fee ×1.

new.name: Bleeding Ink
new.effect: Rubbing: half coefficient, fee ×2, carries Usurious Ink.

new.name: Fair Copy
new.effect: Rubbing from a Way of Ink art node: also carries the original's status and curse.

new.name: Blank Slip
new.effect: A Rubbing any cultivator can slot, stock 2.

new.name: Way of Ink
new.effect: Requires a secret technique. theme_stats than_thuc_pct, ngo_tinh, tam_ma_resist_pct. Branches Rubbing, Ledger, Archive. Keystone Brush Fee. 20 nodes.

new.name: Mimic art
new.effect: An art record with no content that takes its coefficient, kind and tags from the enemy art fired that instant, plus a source tag, copied. Combat rules 6, 10, 13.

questions: Should a copy be able to exceed what the copier could learn, given that a copied art has no lint of its own?
Is it acceptable that a top-end build's toughness can be billed away? A Core Formation copy volley takes one to a double knockout it only wins on overkill.

Patronage as written never pays: a x8 boss's art costs more than your whole pool, so patronage_paid is 0 and the fight is the plain loss at 13 s. Should its cost be measured in your pool, or should it be cut?
